2225-3277-7507-8043.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell for free using Vision this turn.
2225-3277-7507-8043.description:
Cast Kindred Charge for free due to Vision, choosing a creature type granted by Hivestone, creating a token copy of each creature you control with haste, and setting up a delayed exile trigger.
Put the copy of Vision whose ability has been used in your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Izzet Chronarch token enters, it triggers, returning Kindred Charge from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

645-1267-5361-6495.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
Alesha does not have summoning sickness.
645-1267-5361-6495.description:
Declare Alesha as an attacker.
Alesha triggers, causing you to pay {U/B}{U/B} to return Auton Soldier from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped and attacking as a nonlegendary copy of Medomai the Ageless.
Deal combat damage using Auton Soldier.
Auton Soldier triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Auton Soldier
Repeat each turn.

728-2267-7084.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Tormod triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Repeat.

3629-7688-8089.easyPrerequisites: Cloudsteel Kirin attached to a creature you control.
3629-7688-8089.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is a multiple of 3.
3629-7688-8089.description:
Activate M.O.D.O.K. by paying life.
Repeat step 1 until you have 0 life.
Cast Mister Negative by paying {5}{W}{B} plus commander tax if applicable.
When Mister Negative enters, it triggers, swapping your life total with an opponent's.
The opponent loses the game due to having 0 life.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more loyalty counters on it

1308-4094-4365-6763-7942.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight untapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers and Horizon Explorer.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat from step 2

280-3967-6871-7115--44.description:
Cast the artifact by paying {0}.
Toph, Hardheaded Teacher triggers, earthbending Golgari Rot Farm.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Golgari Rot Farm.
When Golgari Rot Farm dies, Toph, Hardheaded Teach triggers, returning Golgari Rot Farm from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Golgari Rot Farm enters, it triggers, returning the artifact cast in step 1 from the battlefield to your hand, as it's a land due to Toph, the First Metalbender.
Resolve the Yahenni ability
Repeat.

requires.n: Goblin, Orc or Army Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

3967-4871-5220-7855--180.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing the Goblin, Orc or Army
When the Goblin, Orc or Army dies, Pitiless Plunderer, The Great Goblin's second ability and Mortuary trigger.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting the Goblin, Orc or Army onto the top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Great Goblin trigger, exiling the Goblin, Orc or Army from the top of your library with the ability to play it until the end of your next turn.
Resolve the Yahenni ability
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Cast the Goblin, Orc or Army from exile by paying its mana cost.
Repeat

475-549-5641-7743.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
475-549-5641-7743.description:
Gain life in any way.
Heroic Feast triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a creature token that enters the battlefield as an artifact due to Biotransference.
Leonin Elder triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

1619-4605-5256-5542-6144.notablePrerequisites: You are able to complete a dungeon.
1619-4605-5256-5542-6144.description:
Complete a dungeon.
Sefris' second ability triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the first trigger, returning up to one other creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the second trigger, returning Goliath Paladin from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
When Goliath Paladin enters, it triggers once and Preston triggers twice due to Delney.
Holding priority, activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Goliath Paladin.
Resolve a Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Goliath Paladin that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Goliath Paladin token enters, it triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the Goliath Paladin token triggers, venturing into Undercity twice.
Resolve the second Preston trigger from step 5, creating a token copy of Goliath Paladin that is a 0/1 Illusion.
Repeat steps 8 and 9 one additional time.
Resolve the Goliath Paladin trigger from step 5, venturing into Undercity and completing Undercity.
Repeat from step 2.
1619-4605-5256-5542-6144.notes: You can choose whatever path you desire while venturing through Undercity.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

3112-5231-6972.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Slurrk.
When Slurrk dies, its innate ability and persist ability trigger.
Resolve Slurrk's innate ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control that already has a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve Slurrk's persist ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with four +1/+1 counters on it due to its replacement effect.
Repeat.

2440-3581-7109-7297.description:
Cast Trusty Boomerang by paying {1}.
Kykar triggers, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
When the Spirit enters, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each Spirit you control.
Activate Trusty Boomerang's equip ability by paying {1}, attaching it to the Spirit token.
Activate the Spirit token by paying {1} and tapping it, tapping a creature a returning Trusty Boomerang from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
2440-3581-7109-7297.notes: The cost can be reduced to as little as {1} if you control other Spirits. You can also sacrifice the Spirits once you have enough to get infinite {R}.

3490-4460-6723-7075.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature that has not been tapped this turn.
3490-4460-6723-7075.description:
Activate a creature by tapping it, adding {1}.
The creature's ability granted to it by Tale of Katara and Toph triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the creature.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat.

628-997-7216.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Moonlit Lamenter.
When Moonlit Lamenter dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability
Repeat.

2034-2919-5086-5183-6705.easyPrerequisites: Triskelavus has two or more +1/+1 counters on it.
2034-2919-5086-5183-6705.description:
Activate Triskelavus by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate a Triskelavite token by sacrificing it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain life.
Archangel of Thune triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing another creature token, adding {C}{C}
Repeat from step 1.

851-2097-4682-5140.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot pay for Smothering Tithe's trigger.
851-2097-4682-5140.description:
Activate Kenrith's fourth ability by paying {3}{U}, causing an opponent who cannot pay for Smothering Tithe's trigger to draw a card.
Smothering Tithe triggers, causing you to create four Treasure tokens due to Jolene and Adrix and Nev.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}{U}.
Repeat.
851-2097-4682-5140.notes: Eventually the opponent will lose the game due to drawing from an empty library. You can repeat this loop with other opponents that also cannot pay for Smothering Tithe's trigger.

2366-4875-6798-6879.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
2366-4875-6798-6879.description:
Play Dryad Arbor.
When Dryad Arbor enters as an Ally due to Conspiracy, Haru triggers, earthbending Dryad Arbor.
Activate Dryad Arbor by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Dryad Arbor.
When Dryad Abor dies, Haru triggers, returning Dryad Arbor from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Dryad Arbor enters as an Ally due to Conspiracy, Haru triggers, earthbending Dryad Arbor.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat from step 3.

944-1069-7070.notablePrerequisites: You control three or more artifacts including an Equipment.
944-1069-7070.description:
Activate an Equipment's equip ability by paying {0} due to Puresteel Paladin, targeting another nontoken creature you control.
Monk Gyatso triggers, airbending the targeted creature.
The equip ability fizzles due to no longer having a legal target.
Cast the creature from exile by paying {0}
Repeat.

413-5220-6535-6900.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Serrated Scorpion.
When Serrated Scorpion dies, it and Mortuary triggers.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Serrated Scorpion from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Serrated Scorpion trigger, causing you to gain 2 life and dealing 2 damage to each opponent.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability.
Cast Serrated Scorpion from the top of your library by paying 1 life due to Gwenom.
When Serrated Scorpion enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Repeat.

2792-3647-5913.notablePrerequisites: You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {2}{U}.
2792-3647-5913.description:
Activate up to seven lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{U}.
Cast Displace by paying {2}{U}, blinking Pinnacle Monk and Great Whale
When Pinnacle Monk and Great Whale enter the battlefield, their abilities trigger.
Resolve the Pinnacle Monk trigger, returning Displace from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Great Whale trigger, untapping up to seven lands.
Repeat.
2792-3647-5913.notes: If you control seven lands that can tap to produce at least {3}{U}, this combo nets infinite mana, and you may blink any other permanent besides Great Whale.

4338-5147-5929.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing any other creature.
When the creature dies as a Cleric due to Leyline of Transformation, Rotlung Reanimator triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.

228-2351-4962-5231.easyPrerequisites:
It is an opponent's turn.
You control another creature with toughness equal to 1.
228-2351-4962-5231.description:
During an opponent's turn, activate Skullclamp's equip ability by paying {1}, attaching it to another creature with toughness equal to 1.
The creature dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness. The Watcher's second ability triggers if the creature was a Tentacle, and Skullclamp triggers.
Resolve the Watcher trigger, if applicable, untapping a Kraken and putting a stun counter on a permanent.
Resolve the Skullclamp trigger, causing you to draw two card.
The Watcher's first ability triggers twice, creating two 1/1 Tentacle creature tokens.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing a Tentacle, adding {R}.
Repeat.

628-2292-6672.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrifiicing Bloodied Ghost.
When Bloodied Ghost dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it. When it enters, Bloodied Ghost will put a -1/-1 counter on itself, removing the +1/+1 counter.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.

856-2511-4321-6462.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Food.
856-2511-4321-6462.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food, returning Cauldron Familiar to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Cauldron Familiar and Kheru Goldkeeper trigger.
Resolve the Kheru Goldkeeper trigger, creating a token and a Food token.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Repeat

2440-2905-3263-4183.notablePrerequisites: Saheeli does not have summoning sickness.
2440-2905-3263-4183.description:
Activate Saheeli by paying {2} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Pestermite with haste.
When the token Pestermite enters the battlefield, it and Mana Echoes trigger.
Resolve the Pestermite trigger, untapping Saheeli.
Resolve the Mana Echoes trigger, adding {C} for each creature you control that shares a creature type with Pestermite.
Repeat.

372-3647-4863.notablePrerequisites: You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Displace exiled by Abdel Adrian.
372-3647-4863.description:
Cast Displace by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Revolutionist and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Revolutionist trigger.
Resolve the Revolutionist trigger, returning Displace from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Displace.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Revolutionist and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

1061-1576-2963.manaNeeded: {2}{U}{U} the first turn, with {3}{U}{U}{U} available each extra turn
1061-1576-2963.notablePrerequisites:
You have the city's blessing.
You have an effect that grants Timestream Navigator haste each turn.
1061-1576-2963.description:
Activate Timestream Navigator by paying {2}{U}{U}, tapping and putting it on the bottom of your library, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, Teleportation Circle triggers, blinking Forerunner of the Coalition.
Forerunner of the Coalition enters, triggering its first ability, causing you to search your library for Timestream Navigator and put it on top of your library.
Move to your next turn, drawing Timestream Navigator during your draw phase.
Cast Timestream Navigator by paying {1}{U}.
Timestream Navigator enters the battlefield, triggering Forerunner of the Coalition's second ability, causing each opponent to lose 1 life.
Repeat.

141-2921-5748.notablePrerequisites: You have at least one historic permanent card in your graveyard.
141-2921-5748.description:
Cast What Must Be Done by paying {3}{W}{W}, targeting any historic permanent card in your graveyard.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying {2}{U}{U}.
When Naru Meha enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting What Must Be Done.
Holding priority, activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Naru Meha, putting a +1/+1 counter on Bartolomé del Presidio.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying What Must Be Done, targeting Naru Meha.
Resolve the copy of What Must Be Done, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield with two +1/+1 counters on it.
Repeat from step 3.

11-551-1484.notablePrerequisites: You control a permanent that can tap to produce at least {U}.
11-551-1484.description:
Activate Primal Wellspring and another mana-producing permanent by tapping them, adding at least {1}{U}.
Cast Hidden Strings by paying {1}{U}, targeting Primal Wellspring and the mana-producing permanent.
Primal Wellspring triggers, copying Hidden Strings, targeting Primal Wellspring and the mana-producing permanent.
Resolve the copy of Hidden Strings, untapping Primal Wellspring and the mana-producing permanent.
Activate Primal Wellspring and the mana-producing permanent by tapping them, adding at least {U}{U}.
Cast Narset's Reversal by paying {U}{U}, targeting Hidden Strings.
Primal Wellspring triggers, copying Narset's Reversal targeting the original Narset's Reversal.
Resolve the copy of Narset's Reversal, copying the original Narset's Reversal targeting Hidden Strings, and returning the original Narset's Reversal to your hand.
Resolve Narset's Reversal, copying Hidden Strings targeting Primal Wellspring and the mana-producing permanent, and returning the original Hidden Strings to your hand.
Resolve the copy of Hidden Strings, untapping Primal Wellspring and the mana-producing permanent.
Repeat.

3276-3496-4071-4452.description:
Cast Dread Slaver by paying {3}{B}{B}.
When Dread Slaver enters the battlefield, Be'lakor's second ability triggers, causing Dread Slaver to deal damage equal to its power to itself.
Dread Slaver dies as a state-based action due to its deathtouch.
Dread Slaver triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

3079-3860-4050-4999.manaNeeded: {1} if you have discarded and/or cycled exactly two cards
3079-3860-4050-4999.notablePrerequisites:
You have discarded and/or cycled at least two cards this turn.
Overwhelming Splendor attached to you.
3079-3860-4050-4999.description:
Cast Hollow One from your graveyard by paying at most {1}.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Hollow One, adding one mana of any color.
Hollow One is not exiled by Abandoned Sarcophagus due to Overwhelming Splendor removing Hollow One's cycling ability.
Repeat.
If you have discarded and/or cycled three or more cards, this combo nets infinite colored mana.

4050-4647-4891-5220.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Atsushi, adding {R}.
When Atsushi dies, it and Mortuary trigger twice.
Resolve both Mortuary triggers, putting Atsushi on top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the first Atsushi trigger, causing you to exile the top two cards of your library with the ability to play them until the end of your next turn.
Resolve the second Atsushi trigger, creating three Treasure tokens.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{R}.
Cast Atsushi from exile by paying {2}{R}{R}.
Repeat.

1707-2034-3356.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one additional creature.
You have the highest life total.
1707-2034-3356.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing another creature, adding {C}{C}.
The creature dies, triggering Last Laugh, dealing 1 damage to each creature and each player.
Polyraptor triggers, creating a token copy of itself.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the damaged Polyraptor, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat from step 2.

1534-2634.description:
Cast an instant or sorcery spell, or wait for an opponent to cast one.
Holding priority, cast Twincast by paying {U}{U}, targeting the spell.
Activate Rootha by paying {2} and returning it to your hand, copying Twincast, with the copy targeting the original Twincast.
Resolve the copy of Twincast, copying Twincast, targeting the original Twincast.
Repeat step 4.

1560-2232-4740.notablePrerequisites:
Your life total is at least 5.
You have a green nonartifact permanent card in hand with mana cost {G}.
You control a nontoken nonartifact green permanent with mana cost {G} that shares a card type with the card in hand.
1560-2232-4740.description:
Cast the green permanent card in your hand by paying 2 life.
Defiler of Vigor and Aetherflux Reservoir triggers.
Resolve the Defiler of Vigor trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Resolve the Aetherflux Reservoir trigger, causing you to gain 1 life for each spell you've cast before it this turn.
The green permanent enters the battlefield, triggering Cloudstone Curio, returning another nontoken nonartifact green permanent with mana cost {G} from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite life, you may activate Aetherflux Reservoir infinite times to deal infinite damage to any target(s).

1980-2385-3681-4703.notablePrerequisites:
Grafted Exoskeleton attached to Brallin.
You have at least six cards in hand.
1980-2385-3681-4703.description:
Cast Change of Fortune by paying {3}{R}.
Swarm Intelligence triggers, creating a copy of Change of Fortune.
Resolve the copy of Change of Fortune, discarding your hand and drawing cards equal to the number of cards you've discarded this turn.
Brallin triggers for each card discarded, putting that many +1/+1 counters on itself and giving each opponent that many poison counters.
Resolve the original Change of Fortune, discarding your hand and drawing cards equal to the number of cards you've discarded this turn.
Brallin triggers for each card discarded, putting that many +1/+1 counters on itself and giving each opponent that many poison counters.
Each opponent loses the game due to having ten or more poison counters.

3020-4050-5189.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent has a creature card in their graveyard.
Puppeteer Clique does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
3020-4050-5189.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Puppeteer Clique, adding {1}.
Puppeteer Clique dies, triggering its persist ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Puppeteer Clique enters the battllefield, putting a creature card from an opponent's graveyard onto the battlefield under your control.
Activate Ghave's second ability by paying {1} and sacrificing the creature your opponent owns, putting a +1/+1 counter on Puppeteer Clique.
Repeat.

1558-4239-4772.notablePrerequisites: Tetravus has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
1558-4239-4772.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Tetravus triggers twice.
If Tetravus has fewer than four +1/+1 counters on it, follow these steps; otherwise, skip to step 7.
Resolve the token making ability, removing all +1/+1 counters from Tetravus and creating twice that many Tetravite tokens.
Resolve the token exiling ability, exiling those tokens and putting twice that many +1/+1 counters on Tetravus.
Move to your next turn.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Tetravus triggers twice.
Resolve the token making ability, removing at least four +1/+1 counters and creating at least eight Tetravite tokens.
Activate Time Sieve by sacrificing five Tetravite tokens, granting you an extra turn after this one.
Resolve the token exiling ability, exiling at least three Tetravite tokens.
Repeat from step 5.
